latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of To Voice Generator — Convert Text to Voiceover Video.

- Instantly converts uploaded text/scripts into natural-sounding English voiceover videos (MP4, 1080p).
- Supports TXT, DOCX, PDF, and MP4 file uploads up to 200MB.
- Automatic cloud session setup and token handling with 100 free credits for new users.
- Simple, prompt-based interface mapped to editing and export actions—no sliders or manual editing required.
- Includes support for video preview, credits checking, session state viewing, and clear error handling.
- Designed for marketers, creators, and educators: fast, installation-free workflow with batch and iterative editing support.
